setupAnchorPromptEn: 9:16 Livestream Setup Reference Sheet (3-panel consistency anchor for host "@tux_kernel"): Panel 1 [0° Primary Live Frame]: 24mm–28mm webcam optics, 5–8° slight downward monitor-top angle, deep f/4.5 room focus, charming 3D studio-lit open-source mascot streamer: plump obsidian-and-snow Linux Tux penguin with golden beak & studio headphones, bright-tangerine (#F74C00) CC0 Rust Ferris crab with round scalloped shell & cute pincers, or cobalt-blue (#478CBF) MIT gear-head robot mascot with top cogs, glowing circular LED eyes, and segmented mouth-bar—rendered in tactile satin-matte vinyl with crisp rim light and zero uncanny humanization, matte-black condenser boom microphone arm entering cleanly from the lower-left edge with foam pop filter (locked to screen-left across all shots), warm 3000K architectural desk lamp pool paired with cool 6500K monitor screen glow across keyboard and hands, quiet cozy late-night room atmosphere, direct eye-contact into the lens as if greeting live chat; Panel 2 [15° Chat-Read Glance]: exact same room, outfit, and mic position, eyes flicked 15 degrees off-axis reading a glowing secondary chat monitor with subtle smile; Panel 3 [Rig & Optical Side Diagram]: clean side-view showing camera mount distance, ring-light placement, and room background props. Clean raw camera feed, zero burned-in UI text, zero platform watermarks.
setupAnchorPromptZh: 9:16 直播间跨镜头一致性三态锚定参考卡（主播「@tux_kernel」）：左格【0°主镜头直视态】：24mm–28mm广角桌面摄像头光学，显示器顶端5°–8°微俯拍，f/4.5清晰房间景深（不虚化死背景），精致3D棚拍级开源吉祥物角色主播：圆润黑白配金黄扁嘴的戴耳机Linux企鹅Tux、活力亮橙色(#F74C00)圆壳大眼CC0开源小螃蟹Ferris，或钴蓝色(#478CBF)头顶齿轮配发光圆眼与分段嘴条的MIT开源机器人主播——哑光潮玩软胶质感配通透轮廓光，零恐怖谷人像感，哑光黑悬臂电容麦克风配防喷棉从画面左下角伸入（全片跨镜头严格锁死左侧，严禁左右乱跳），3000K暖黄台灯光晕搭配6500K显示器冷蓝屏幕光洒在键盘与手部，静谧深夜陪伴直播氛围，眼神0°直视镜头向直播间观众打招呼；中格【15°偏轴读弹幕态】：完全相同的房间陈设、穿搭与麦克风左右位置，视线偏转15°扫向副屏弹幕并露出实时反应；右格【机位与补光侧视锚点】：清晰交代摄像头架设距离、环形灯/霓虹光源方位与背景固定摆件。画面保持100%纯净无UI文字底片，零平台水印、零乱码弹幕。
